subject: english
title: Unit 6 Reading
subtitle: "Colorful Corals" — corals are animals, not plants, and the reefs are disappearing.

content: Read "Colorful Corals" and explain that corals are animals, not plants.
Contrast warm-water and cold-water polyps — where they live and what they eat.
Say why coral reefs matter to people and why they are in danger.
language: Complete four definitions with polyps, algae, plankton and colonies (Activity 2).
Label a diagram of a coral polyp: mouth, tentacle, stomach (Activity 3).
Use the seven content words from the passage in sentences of his own.

notes: The four-paragraph passage is verbatim from the Student Book pp. 102-103 (audio TR 6.9), including the headings and the Great Barrier Reef fact box; each of its 22 sentences was checked against the book text. The answer keys for Activities 2, 3 and 4 are the book's own. This reading feeds the Writing lesson, which asks Leo to write a contrast paragraph about warm and cold corals.
